title: Dual and output transport of a local evaluation component
statement: For a scheme X and open U with over-site complexes P,F, a natural termwise Hom comparison e and projection-pinned b, let d be the Hom comparison of the canonical single-unit isomorphism. For a symmetric core monoidal structure m normalized at the unit and p+q=n, id tensor d inverse followed by the forward tensorator, the image of the local component [def-pc-ordinary-evaluation-data], and the output comparison is the actual scheme component [def-pc-scheme-ordinary-evaluation-component]. No f or total tensor comparison c occurs.

proof.text: Apply openModule_contraction_transport to the dual projection and d inverse. Apply ordinaryEvaluation_over_dual_projection to identify the resulting dual input. The degree transport is preserved by the degreewise functor, proved by equality elimination and map_id. Supply these two equations to the contraction transport theorem and identify its conclusion with the component formula by explicitly reducing homComplex and converting the degreewise component formula with congruence. If r+q is nonzero, unfold the two components and use map_zero and composition with zero.
